themes.label: Thin / tinny metal
quotes: Very tinny, but looks OK with a candle in it
Thin metal and not sure how long they will last through winter
themes.fix: Specify a heavier metal gauge and state it on the spec sheet.

themes.label: Loose glass, bent door or catches
quotes: all glass was loose when we opened it
themes.fix: Secure glass with clips and silicone; QC-test doors and latches before packing.

themes.label: Glass broken or damaged in transit
quotes: the large one arrived with a significant smash
one had a shattered glass shade
themes.fix: Use double-wall cartons with moulded pulp inserts, mark FRAGILE; drop-test to ISTA 1A.

themes.label: Poor finish: paint chips, sharp edges
quotes: a few paint chips around the neck
the metal is very sharp on all the edges
themes.fix: Deburr all edges and add paint-finish QC; use durable baked coating.

themes.label: Nested set hard to unpack
quotes: Slightly tricky to get smaller lantern out of the large one
It was a bit awkward getting the smaller one out
themes.fix: Pack nested lanterns separately or add a pull-tab insert for easy removal.

themes.label: Beautiful look and glow

Looked even nicer than the picture.

summary_md:
**Verdict: GO. Market score estimate 62/100.** Estimated quote: £7.73 (₹986) per piece via an importer, or £13.92 (₹1,774) direct to a retailer. Your cost is ₹710. Estimated margin is 28% via an importer and 60% direct. The UK retail median is £42.27 across 224 listings [ev:google_shopping:4a6b7706:0]. Some of these are electric or oil lamps.

**Demand and timing:** Estimated interest is 36/100, up 4% year on year. This uses the broader term "candle lantern" [ev:google_trends:734c2fba:0]. Interest peaks Oct–Dec. Buyers choose ranges around Apr–Jun, 7 months from now.

**Competition and origin:** 5 of 6 Amazon products checked are made in China, and 0 in India. On eBay, 7 of 60 listings are in India [ev:ebay:ea8dfc0d:2]. Duty from India is 0% under the India-UK CETA, but only with valid proof of origin.

**Top complaints:** thin metal [ev:amazon_product:6eb52424:review.1], loose glass or bent doors [ev:amazon_product:6eb52424:review.0], glass broken in transit [ev:amazon_product:3a79d7c6:review.4], and paint chips or sharp edges [ev:amazon_product:77d2ac65:review.2]. Customers love the look and glow [ev:amazon_product:6eb52424:review.4].

**Buyers:** Contact Kayu Home first. It sells brass lanterns and sources Indian pieces [ev:google_shopping:4a6b7706:34]. Then try Casa by JJ [ev:google_shopping:4a6b7706:33] and Turquoise Living [ev:google_shopping:4a6b7706:35], which sell hurricane lanterns. Online Lighting and Electricpoint score higher but sell electric pendants [ev:google_shopping:2ae8396b:1]. Check their fit first.

**Next step:** Make a sample that fixes these complaints. Then email Kayu Home before April.
spec_improvements: Use a heavier brass gauge and state the thickness on the spec sheet so the lantern does not feel tinny.
Hold each glass panel with metal clips and silicone, and test every door and latch before packing.
Pack each lantern in a double-wall carton with moulded pulp inserts, mark it FRAGILE, and drop-test to ISTA 1A.
Deburr all edges and use a durable baked coating, with a paint-finish check at final QC.
For nested sets, pack each lantern separately or add a pull-tab insert so the smaller one lifts out easily.
